Validation_Type.reason: Confirmed. No predictive model is fitted or validated. The analyses are multilevel models of longitudinal group differences between superagers, cognitively normal and PD-MCI patients (689, PPMI) in MoCA, GDS, STAI-T and UPDRS-III over 10 years. Two sensitivity analyses follow: restriction to age >=70, and a CSF analysis (ANOVA of baseline CSF markers across groups, with the markers that differed added as covariates to the aim-1 models). A search of the full text finds no train/test split, held-out partition, cross-validation or external test set; 'classified' refers only to the rule-based baseline group assignment. The convention codes a non-model study V2. V3 (k-fold + held-out test partition) has no basis in the paper.
Validation_Type.quote: Multilevel modeling examined differences between the three cognitive groups (superagers, PD-MCI, cognitively normal) and dependent variables. A separate multilevel modeling analysis was performed for each dependent variable.
